hardware.python_prefer: 3.11 or 3.12, with compatible verified stable CUDA-enabled PyTorch
hardware.platform: native Windows first; WSL2 only if required and proved beneficial

autonomy_policy.scheduler: deterministic Python process, resumable with work/manifest file state
autonomy_policy.subagents: max 2 independent code/QA workstreams only; never per experiment
autonomy_policy.supervision: process log and checkpoint/status.json; escalate only genuine unrecoverable blockers
autonomy_policy.automatic_fix: only deterministic and audited runtime actions (OOM microbatch reduction preserving effective batch, bounded CG tolerance/iteration escalation, retries on transient IO)
autonomy_policy.forbidden: change scientific outcome thresholds, cherry-pick seeds, replace GGN with empirical Fisher, fabricate tests or results
autonomy_policy.failed_runs: retained as INVALID or FAIL with reason, not discarded
autonomy_policy.storage: All working/cache/data/temp and bulky outputs on E:\GENESIS. C: only unavoidable Windows/driver/system use; never fallback to C: without explicit user consent.

checks: JVP/VJP HVP and GGN-vs-dense on tiny MSE and CE models
dense inverse block energies vs Rademacher and matrix-free CG
blockwise precise CG vs dense block solve
numerical solver error vs scientific effect floor
all physical training checkpoints from a fixed objective

s1_discovery.pre_frozen_setup: Lock all configs/data/seed schedules/analysis and S2 selection before opening S1 science

configs.data: synthetic fixed teacher, per-seed independent train/test
same frozen teacher/data protocol, new independent seeds

configs.dataset: MNIST; public source/version/splits and license recorded
CIFAR-10 with GroupNorm and frozen train/validation splits
public-domain character-level corpus with exact source/license SHA

analysis.distance_profiles: all bins for GGN inverse and raw GGN
analysis.utility: same gradient precise layerwise vs full GGN, optimal scalar oracle

s2_confirmatory.optional_S1_selected_arms: max one positive and one negative condition selected by PRE_FROZEN rule, 16 new seeds per arm; no duplicate anchors
s2_confirmatory.fixed_seed_count_reason: 16 fresh seed clusters per anchor chosen before data because GPU time is not budget limited; checkpoint/lambda repeats do not increase n

s3_optimizer.new_algorithm: optional low-rank or Krylov correction only after predictive utility evidence

controls.GGN_for_CE: J_logits^T * H_CE_logits * J_logits, not empirical Fisher
controls.layerwise_definition: exact blockdiag(GGN + lambda I) solve to comparable residual, else report approximate and do not promote

evidence_outputs.run_state: state.sqlite or state.json with atomic writes and locks
evidence_outputs.raw_results_policy: never automatically publish or delete, save hashed local CSV/NPZ/checkpoints
evidence_outputs.git_policy: commit source/config/compact auditable summary only; branch and PR, no main merge without owner approval

no_infinite_repeat: All experiments finite by locked config; unlimited GPU time only permits sufficient repetitions and numerical rechecks, not threshold shopping.

prefer_E_for: git working files and Codex worktree
Python venv and pip/uv build caches
PyTorch CUDA-related downloaded wheels and extension/cache outputs
intermediate NPZ, checkpoints, raw probe results and temporary files
CUDA kernel caches, model checkpoints, training results, logs and reports
storage_policy.safe_disk_management: Prefer compress/deduplicate generated scratch/checkpoints only under E with manifest and retention policy; never silently delete evidence
storage_policy.bootstrap: Dot-source scripts/prepare_local_e_drive.ps1 in the shell that launches Codex-owned Python processes; preserve local Windows/global environment
